text:
Jon: quick follow-up from the RFC — proposing we add a `pin_expiry` (TTL in seconds) to rollout metadata so temporary experiments auto-unpin. Thoughts?
Maria: noted. we talked about TTLs yesterday — main risk is accidental unpin during long experiments :thinking:. can we support a `persistent` override? also how do rollbacks interact with expiry?
Alex: i don't love two flags. prefer a single `pin_lifecycle` enum: `permanent | temporary | sticky`. semantics: `permanent` never auto-unpins, `temporary` auto-unpins after ttl, `sticky` auto-unpins but can be extended. example:```json
{"pin_lifecycle": "temporary", "pin_ttl_seconds": 86400, "grace_seconds": 30}```
Priya: compatibility question — existing agents only send `pin: true/false`. we should read both and migrate: if `pin_lifecycle` exists use it, else map `pin=true` -> `permanent`. migration doc should cover server-side defaults.
Jon: good call. API/UI needs: show expiry countdown in console, add `extend` action, and PATCH route `PATCH /rollouts/:id { "extend_ttl": 3600 }` to extend.
Alex: another edge-case: what if a pinned model expires mid-request and fallback routing kicks in? we need transactional semantics — delay expiry until inflight requests complete or add `grace_seconds` to keep serving a bit longer. :warning:
Priya: agree on grace. default `grace_seconds=30` seems fine. also suggest adding `created_by` and `created_at` metadata so TTL inheritance and audits are clear.
Maria: @Jon also: metrics + alerts — if a pinned model is about to expire and traffic > threshold, emit a `pin_expiry_warning` event and surface it in console. i'll own the instrumentation.
sre-bot: deploy-check: rollout-metadata-schema v2 queued for canary. tests: schema-backcompat, expiry-handling, extend-path. ETA 12:47 PDT.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary start infra-2026-03-20-09 rolling to 10% clusters.
Jon: summary/action items: Priya writes migration plan + backcompat tests; Alex drafts enum + grace semantics and server-side expiry handshake; Maria adds console signal + alerting; i will own the API patch (PATCH extend). PRs by EOD? :thumbsup:
Priya: on it, will ping when draft is ready.
